verdict.rationale: Summer Engine's own materials say users describe the game they want in natural language and Summer builds it. Users can also bring their own agent (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) to run publishing and read analytics through the MCP server or CLI, and the model can pull Summer docs in-chat. All of this evidence is vendor marketing or docs with no hands-on proof. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation, detailed docs on the scope and limits of natural-language commands inside the engine.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Describe the game you want and Summer builds it with you in a full engine: 2D and 3D, physics, animation and real gameplay.
Your agent runs the whole publishing flow on Summer Games through the MCP or CLI.
Bring Claude Code, Codex, Hermes or whatever agent you prefer, and it gets the same tools.
The MCP server ships summer\_docs\_search and summer\_docs\_read, so the model can pull Summer guidance in-chat.
